newsitem.title: USA: Computer Sciences down on EDS woes - analysts.
newsitem.headline: Computer Sciences down on EDS woes - analysts.

text.p: Shares of computer services firm Computer Sciences Corp dropped about 7.4 percent Friday following weaker-than-expected first quarter earnings from rival Electronic Data Systems Corp, analysts said.

"They are down in sympathy with EDS. EDS' results are putting a shadow on the industry's potential revenues," said Moshe Katri, an analyst with Oppenheimer & Co. "But EDS' problems are company-specific."

Electronic Data Systems' first quarter earnings $0.40 a share were about 20 percent below analysts estimates, and 11 percent below last year's first quarter results of $0.45 a share. Shares of EDS dropped about 23 percent Friday.
But Computer Sciences' fundamentals remain strong, analysts said.

Analysts also said that El Segundo, Calif.-based Computer Sciences has indicated it is comfortable with the consensus Wall Street fourth quarter earnings forecast of $0.95 a share, compared with $0.18 a share last year.
Computer Sciences officials did not return calls seeking comment.
